sentences.text: RWE's management team remains unchanged, with Markus Krebber as CEO, Michael Mueller as CFO and Katja van Doren as CHRO; as of the August 2026 Factbook, Krebber is appointed until 2031, Mueller until 2028 and van Doren until 2029, following the Supervisory Board's early five-year extension of Krebber's contract to the end of June 2031, announced on 9 July 2025.

citations.title: Elliott Investment Management Calls on RWE to Increase Shareholder Returns

sentences.text: Under Markus Krebber, RWE has kept delivering on its Growing Green build-out: about EUR 11 bn gross invested in generation in 2025, more than 60 new-build projects commissioned and capacity up 2.8 GW, with leverage at 2.1x, well inside the self-imposed 3.0 limit.

On capital allocation, management responded to tougher conditions by raising the required return on new projects from 8% to above 8.5%, cutting planned 2025-2030 net investment by EUR 10 bn and redirecting funds into a buyback of up to EUR 1.5 bn.

citations.title: RWE delivers strong financial performance in 2025 and sets course for exceptional earnings growth until 2031

sentences.quote: With total net investments of EUR 42 billion through to 2031, we will consistently capitalise on these opportunities in a value-accretive way.
sentences.text: RWE plans net investments of about 35 billion euros between 2026 and 2031 to lift renewable, battery storage and flexible generation capacity by 25 GW to roughly 65 GW, at expected portfolio returns above 8.5 percent.

sentences.quote: Majority of investments earmarked for flexible generation in Germany and power generation in the United States - including new gas-fired power plants
sentences.text: The bulk of this spending targets flexible generation in Germany and power generation in the United States, including new gas-fired plants, where RWE is broadening its portfolio beyond renewables.

sentences.quote: adjusted earnings per share expected to grow by an average of 10% annually through to 2031, reaching EUR 4.55 per share in 2031
sentences.text: Management guides adjusted net income per share from 2.48 euros to about 4.40 euros by 2031 and targets 10 percent annual dividend growth, with 1.32 euros per share envisaged for fiscal 2026.
First-half 2026 adjusted EBITDA rose more than 40 percent to 3.0 billion euros and adjusted earnings per share increased to 1.77 euros from 1.08 euros, prompting raised 2026 and 2027 guidance.

sentences.quote: The renewables investor Masdar, Norges Bank Investment Management, which manages the Norwegian sovereign wealth fund, and US financial investor KKR have been brought on board as co-investors
sentences.text: Partnerships with Masdar, Norges Bank Investment Management, KKR and Apollo Global Management limit project risk and widen financial headroom.
